meta.title: Growth percent plus margin percent
meta.summary: SAMPLE 30% growth and 15% margin → 45, later-stage smell test around 40.

success.message:
Session complete. Rule of 40 ≈ growth% + margin%. Later-stage smell, not a law of physics.

SAMPLE: 30+15=45 pass; 80−50=30 miss. Solve for the gap: 25% growth needs a +15% margin.

start.message:
SAMPLE: 30% growth, 15% profit margin. Rule of 40?

Operation?

choices.label: Use 30 only because growth is the 40

wrong_start_product.message:
The rule is a sum of two percents, not a product.

Return to the sum.

wrong_start_growth_only.message:
You still add margin. High growth with negative margin can fail.

Return to the sum.

wrong_pass_fail.message:
The test is the sum, not each term.

Revisit the read.

wrong_pass_early.message:
It is a later-stage heuristic. Still compute the sum; do not weaponize it on a pre-revenue SAMPLE.

Revisit the read.

wrong_check_80.message:
Margin is in the sum. 80−50=30.

Try the check again.

wrong_check_130.message:
The margin is negative.

Try the check again.

solve.message:
Growth is 25%.

What margin do you need to reach 40?

choices.label: A 15% loss is fine — the gap is 15 either way

wrong_solve_sixtyfive.message:
40 is the target sum, not something to add on. 40 − 25 = 15.

Back to solving for the margin.

wrong_solve_loss.message:
A loss subtracts: 25 − 15 = 10. You need +15%.

Back to solving for the margin.
